title: Colossus: Colossus of the Drylands
description: Table tools for the Colossus of the Drylands campaign frame of the Daggerheart Core Rulebook, built on the system's colossus adversaries. A live Colossus Board shows every segment as a card in the colossus's shape, with HP, Broken tokens and the PCs climbing it; segment rules (Fatal, Chain, Strike, Armored, Weak Point, Invulnerable, Protected, Cascade, Collapse) are automated; segment tokens are arranged in the colossus's shape; and the Emergence of Kudamat tracks the Siphoning Track, Kudamat's Power and the colossi slain. Comes with Ikeri, Daktadae, Poy and Kelir, and the example colossus features.
